name: learning
description: Personal learning knowledge base with mentor personas. Topics: investing (Warren Buffett), real-estate (Grant Cardone).

commands.description: List all learning topics with stats (notes, wiki articles, curriculum progress, open questions)
Quick-capture a note to a topic's daily notes file
Show a topic's baseline knowledge and mentor persona
Show a topic's learning curriculum with progress

prompt_doc: Learning knowledge base via `python3 integrations/learning/cli.py <cmd>`. Commands: `topics` (list all topics + stats), `note <topic> <content>` (quick-capture), `baseline <topic>` (show knowledge level + mentor), `curriculum <topic>` (show learning path + progress). For interactive learning sessions or mentor Q&A, use the /learn skill instead.
